unmarked: Nothing is drawn on this frame. It is a judgement frame, and an outline drawn on a frame inflates a vision model's score of it, so marking it would corrupt the question. There is no palette either: `palette` names OUTLINE colours and never a thing's own material, so no colour named anywhere binds to what you see here — read the colours off the pixels. `silhouette` is the subject's traced outline in this image's percent coordinates, measured, not drawn. There is no description either — nothing here tells you what anything is, so read the picture.
